info.title: Muskdeer management HTTP API
info.description: Existing management boundary; simulation acceptance does not authorize production trading. All replies use Cache-Control: no-store. Fixed Host is enforced. Writes require the configured exact Origin. Feature-disabled routes return 404. Public JSON uses snake_case and decimal strings for every int64 and financial decimal. Money/price/quantity/rate precision, authorization, duplicate JSON names, byte limits and cross-field invariants are also enforced by delivery/domain validation; schema validation alone is insufficient. No server address or credential is included. The two cookie schemes are deployment alternatives. Read observations never grant execution ownership or risk permission.

Only listed single-value query names are accepted; positive IDs and nonnegative cursors are canonical int64 strings. Default page limit 50 (maximum 100), except service overview.
